observations: Exact common.py UTF-8 byte size, SHA256 and Git blob SHA1 independently recomputed; recursive canonical tree is not truncated and binds this regular leaf.
parent_descriptor walks from a held '/' descriptor using O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC for every ancestor, retaining all opened directory descriptors until operation completion.
Both before yield and after successful yield, each held child descriptor's device/inode/mode/uid/gid is compared with the same named entry under its still-held parent using follow_symlinks=False.

inspect_file requires a regular leaf, bounded nonnegative size and the appropriate owned-single-link or system-binary identity before opening. O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK prevents following a replacement link or blocking on a swapped FIFO.

The leaf descriptor is compared to the original complete identity before any read; actual byte count plus complete descriptor and named-leaf identity must match after reading before a result pin can return.
reserve is called after the verified leaf descriptor exists and before payload reading. If it raises, the leaf and ancestor descriptors still close and no success pin returns.
create uses O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, mode0400, and a single O_RDWR descriptor for full writes, fsync, seek and independent byte readback.

The created leaf must be regular, owned, nlink1, mode0400 and the expected byte size; full descriptor/name identity and actual byte equality are required before the pin can return. The context manager's parent-spine post-check still runs before that return completes.
Ancestor identity intentionally excludes directory atime/mtime/size/nlink, so creating a child does not falsely require immutable directory metadata. Device/inode/type/mode/owner remain checked.

On an exceptional operation, control jumps to descriptor cleanup and does not run the post-yield stability check. This does not establish preservation on a failed path, but cannot manufacture a successful file pin; caller HOLD semantics remain necessary.
These checks bind operation-time observations. They do not claim immunity to subsequent namespace changes or hostile concurrent edits after the final observation.
The remainder of common.py from def save onward is byte-identical to the previously reviewed b272 common source.
scope_exclusions: No Python parse, import, descriptor fault injection, product execution, native compilation, remote h call or Actions trigger.
No renewed clearance for complete diagnostics framing, policy/workflow, preparation admission, 116 product results, or the other Core control sources.
No new claim that failed operations preserve all source identities, or that any operation is atomically immune to all future mutation.
Original e03f/b272 review boundaries and all unexecuted/development statuses remain unchanged.
conclusion: No new blocker found in this exact fixed-path read/create mechanism. The status is a narrow static review, not a runtime race-test result.
